title: fix(plugin-security)!: a delegated business-unit subtree stays inside one organization, whether or not the caller's context names one
body:
security#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdqWnb3ndnEacKvJvF Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — a runtime authorization bound inside `@objectstack/plugin-security`; no authorable key, value or metadata type changes, and no `skills/**` or docs page teaches the delegated subtree's organization bound. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:委派管理(adminScope)覆盖的业务单元子树只含一个组织的单元——调用方上下文指明组织时是该组织,未指明时是作用域根单元自己的组织;子树遍历的组织参数改为每个调用方必填。 - 为什么改:落实规则「委派的业务单元子树永不跨越组织边界,无论调用方上下文是否指明组织」(安全加固,细节归 security#1 席)。 - 风险与回滚:低。上下文指明组织时所有答案不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR(一个源文件、两个测试文件、一个 changeset)。 - 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`(`resolveSubtree` 末行传入的组织界、`resolveSubtreeById` 的必填组织参数与逐行过滤、`delegatorAnchorSubtree` 的无组织早返回);`delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` 末尾的新 describe。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts src/delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中新 describe 两个(三种部署形态各四例加 `single` 一例,桩引擎四例)。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes - **Rule.** A delegated business-unit subtree never crosses an organization boundary, whether or not the caller's context names an organization. The subtree is the units of ONE organization — the caller's when its context names one (every answer unchanged), otherwise the scope root's own — and a unit stamped with another organization is outside it, as is every unit below it, even where its parent link names a unit inside the scope. - **Structure.** The subtree walk (`resolveSubtreeById`) now takes that organization as a required argument from every caller, so no caller can ask for an unbounded walk; it reads and keeps that organization's units only. The by-name scope path passes the caller's organization, else the root row's own. The self-delegation anchor path answers nothing for a context naming no organization (a holding takes effect only in its own organization, so there is no holding to anchor and no organization to bound a walk to), which is what it already answered. - **An organization-less root** (a store whose units carry no organization at all) keeps its organization-less descendants only: such a store's tree stays whole, and no stamped unit is reached from it or reaches it. The alternative, an organization-less root approving only itself, was measured (Verification) and not taken. - **Every answer that reads the subtree follows**, with no second traversal: the delegated business-unit read (the read door, `canReadObject`, `getReadFilter`, `security/explain`), assignment and direct-grant writes under the scope, `describeDelegableScope` and `scopesCoverUser`. - Rulings carried unchanged: ADR-0090 D12 (and its 2026-10-17 amendment, ruling of record 6228728551), rulings of record 5985885287, 6663849489 ("no unit outside the scopes the caller holds … A scope that cannot be resolved admits nothing (fail closed)"), 6649064874, and the ruling on #26059 Q3. Nothing here widens any of them; the refusal class for a unit outside the subtree stays `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`. ## Tests - `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` (the posture rig: a real `ObjectQL` over a real `SqlDriver` with the real `SecurityPlugin`), new top-level describe, run in `single`, `group` and `isolated`: ground truth on the store; the gate's covered units, placeable units and user coverage, with and without an organization on the context; the read door; the write gate refusing an assignment anchored in, and a direct grant to a member of, another organization's unit with `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` while admitting one inside the scope; and, under `single` with its Default Organization installed, the write door refusing and storing nothing, then storing the in-scope control. - `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`, new top-level describe on the file's existing context-ignoring double: a stamped root and an organization-less root, each with a control that a unit of the root's own organization under the same link stays inside. - Rejections assert the envelope (`code` + `status`), never a bare throw; every refusal pin has an admitted control beside it. ## Acceptance notes - No card: a `security#1` no-card order. No `Fixes` line. - `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` confirmed against the diff: answers the gate gave for a unit outside its subtree's organization become refusals or omissions; no export, error code, status or authorable key is added. - Local scope per the dispatch contract: the package's own `test` and `typecheck`, the derived gate families, and the full dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm). The `repo` vitest project and the whole-repo build gates are CI's. - `origin/main` was merged once before this PR (merge base `fe97d85b0`); it has moved since with no change under `packages/plugins/plugin-security/`, so it is not merged again here. ## Verification Head `19f8d05ea`. Every reading below names its run; restores are proven by blob hash against `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
Red, then green: the source file at the dispatch base, the tests at head (commit fbd64ad97) - Three gate test files (`delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`, `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts`, `delegated-admin-gate-cross-organization.test.ts`): **10 failed / 229 passed** with the source at the dispatch base — only new rule pins red; every control and ground-truth case green. - Restored to `HEAD`: **239 / 239 passed**.
Ablation: the walk's per-row organization guard deleted - **6 failed / 233 passed** over the same three files; restored (blob equal to `HEAD`, empty diff): 239 / 239.
The organization-less root: the alternative bound, measured and not taken - An organization-less root approving only itself: **26 failed / 946 passed** across the 20 test files of the package that exercise delegated scopes, all in the gate's own unit file (organization-less stores). Kept: organization-less descendants only. Restored (blob equal to `HEAD`).
Package, gates, dogfood - `@objectstack/plugin-security` full suite: **248 files passed; 5841 passed / 45 skipped**. - `@objectstack/plugin-security` `build` and `typecheck` (`tsc`, the scripts project, and the test layer: 0 files / 0 errors in its debt ledger): exit 0. ESLint over the three changed source files: clean. - Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, reconciled with `--ran`): **62 derived, 61 run at exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED** — `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads a whole-repo build; CI runs it). `check:dts-closure` and `check:type-check-debt` were re-run after a concurrent closure build and the lock queue respectively, both exit 0. - `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` (`@objectstack/core`, `repo` project): the diff adds no call of the reference-target arbiter; **4 / 4 passed**. - Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, closure built first): **435 files passed / 3 skipped; 3609 passed / 41 skipped**, exit 0. - Control-byte scan over the four changed files: no hits.
